title: Jim Cramer Says ‘Never Count This Man Out’ as Elon Musk Calls Starlink V3 a ‘Gamechanger’ After SpaceX’s Next-Generation Satellites Reach Space

CNBC host Jim Cramer urged investors not to dismiss Elon Musk after SpaceX's first Starlink V3 satellites completed a demonstration in space, highlighting Musk's record of delivering breakthroughs after years of skepticism.

Cramer Hails Musk After Starlink Breakthrough

Musk called the spacecraft a "gamechanger" on X. Cramer reposted the message and wrote, "Why you must NEVER count this man out!! EVER," echoing his praise for Musk and SpaceX.

The reaction followed Starship's 13th test flight from Starbase, Texas, on July 24. The 407-foot rocket released 20 V3 satellites about 124 miles above Earth before they followed the planned suborbital path and burned up during reentry. Reuters said they briefly connected with Starlink's network of 10,000 satellites.

The mission advanced SpaceX's shift from Falcon 9 to Starship for next-generation deployments. The V3 units extended solar arrays, activated thrusters and antennas, exchanged data through radio links and lasers, and photographed Starship's heat shield before reentry, according to SpaceX.

V3 Satellites Promise Massive Capacity Gains

Each V3 satellite is designed to provide 1 terabit per second of downlink capacity and 160 gigabits per second of uplink capacity, about 10 times and 22 times the respective capacity of V2 spacecraft. Starlink says the design supports 2,048 communication beams each way, six 400-gigabit space lasers and solar arrays generating twice the power.

One Starship launch could add about 20 times as much network capacity as a Falcon 9 mission carrying V2 satellites, Starlink said. The expansion supports Musk's claim that Starlink could eventually become the internet's core infrastructure rather than another broadband provider.

Cramer has warned that Starlink could become a "considerable competitor" to traditional telecommunications companies in rural markets. His endorsement follows investor debate over whether SpaceX's growth prospects justify enthusiasm surrounding Musk's satellite, launch and orbital-computing plans.

克莱默在星链突破后称赞马斯克

马斯克称该航天器是 X 上的“游戏规则改变者”。 克莱默转发了这条消息并写道：“为什么你永远不能把这个人排除在外！！ 永远”，呼应了他对马斯克和 SpaceX 的赞扬。

7 月 24 日，Starship 从德克萨斯州 Starbase 进行了第 13 次试飞后，出现了上述反应。 这艘 407 英尺长的火箭在距地球约 124 英里的地方释放了 20 颗 V3 卫星，然后它们沿着计划的亚轨道路径飞行，并在重返大气层时被烧毁。 路透社称，他们与星链的 10,000 颗卫星网络进行了短暂连接。

此次任务推动了 SpaceX 从 Falcon 9 号向 Starship 的转变，以进行下一代部署。 据 SpaceX 称，V3 装置扩展了太阳能电池阵列，激活了推进器和天线，通过无线电链路和激光交换数据，并在重返大气层之前拍摄了星舰的隔热罩。

V3 卫星有望带来巨大的容量增益

每颗V3卫星的设计目标是提供每秒1太比特的下行链路容量和每秒160吉比特的上行链路容量，分别约为V2航天器容量的10倍和22倍。 Starlink 表示，该设计支持单路 2,048 个通信光束、6 个 400 吉比特的空间激光器和产生两倍功率的太阳能电池阵列。

Starlink 表示，一次 Starship 发射可以增加约 20 倍于搭载 V2 卫星的 Falcon 9 任务的网络容量。 这次扩张支持了马斯克的说法，即星链最终可能成为互联网的核心基础设施，而不是另一个宽带提供商。

趋势：避免第一大投资错误：你的“安全”持仓可能会让你付出巨大的代价

克莱默警告说，星链可能成为农村市场传统电信公司的“有力竞争对手”。 在他的支持之前，投资者就 SpaceX 的增长前景是否值得人们对马斯克的卫星、发射和轨道计算计划抱有热情展开了争论。
